item.title: Galaxy A57 Dual SIM 5G | 12+256GB | 6.7" Super AMOLED Infinity-O Display | 50MP OIS and VDIS | 1 Year Warranty
item.description:
6.7" HD+ Super AMOLED+ Infinity-O Display, 120Hz refresh rate with 1900 nits peak brightness, IP 68 Dust and Water Resistant, 50MP OIS HDR Video Main Camera Enhanced ISP + 5MP Macro Lense + 12MP HDR Video Front Camera, Awesome Intelligence, 6 Years Security Updates + 6 Times OS Updates, Secured by Samsung Knox Vault, 8GB RAM +  128GB Storage,  5,000 mAh, 45W Fast Charging - up to 65% in  30 minutes, Exynos 1680 , Wi-Fi 6E, One UI 8.5

About this item (Samsung Galaxy A57):
•How slim is Galaxy A57 5G? Galaxy A57 5G has a slimmer design compared to the previous model with reduced thickness of only 6.9 mm, making it sleek and easy to grip in one hand. The bezels around the 6.7-inch FHD+ Super AMOLED Plus display have also been slimmed down all around, providing a more immersive, uninterrupted viewing experience.

•What intelligent features are available on Galaxy A57 5G? Galaxy A57 5G supports intelligent features such as Circle to Search, Voice transcription, Object Eraser, Edit suggestion, Filters, Auto Trim and Best Face.
•What camera features are available on Galaxy A57 5G? Galaxy A57 5G features an upgraded rear camera system with a 50 MP OIS Wide-angle Camera, a 12 MP Ultra Wide Camera and a 5 MP Macro Camera, letting you take photos and videos that are bright, crisp and detailed. The Wide Camera supports enhanced ISP for improved Nightography, absorbing more light for brighter and sharper videos in low-light conditions. And with 12 MP Super HDR support on the Front Camera, your selfie videos are more vibrant than ever with enhanced saturation, color and contrast.

•Is Galaxy A57 5G waterproof? Yes, Galaxy A57 5G is waterproof with an IP68 rating, which means it can withstand water and dust.

•How long does the battery of Galaxy A57 5G last and how fast does it charge? Galaxy A57 5G features a long-lasting 5,000 mAh (typical) battery that lasts 2 days for extended phone use without needing to recharge. To power up, use Super Fast Charging 2.0 and charge up to 60% in just 30 minutes.

•How many OS upgrades does Galaxy A57 5G support? Galaxy A57 5G supports up to 6x of OS upgrades and up to 6 years of security updates.
